assets.name: bridgeworks
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque wide 16:9 pixel-art educational game backdrop for Lumora's Numeric Ruins floating island. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, classic 16-bit adventure scenery. Moss-green grassy ledges, warm sandstone ruins, vines, distant blue-gray mountains and white clouds below floating land. Warm upper-left sunlight. Composition: active environmental illustration in the LEFT THIRD; right two-thirds is a quiet lightly textured stone courtyard fading toward pale sky, reserved for a readable game workbench. No characters, no text, no numbers, no symbols, no UI, no watermark. A small stone bridge workshop at the edge of two floating grassy ledges, a gap with wooden guide rails, stacks of ochre and turquoise cut stone and a little winding path. Calm optimistic morning.
